subject.title: fix: keep native i18n release gates off Blacksmith

question: Should maintainers merge this protected-label CI release-gate fix once the branch is current with main?
rationale: The patch is correct and proven, but the protected `maintainer` label and behind merge state make this a maintainer-handled merge rather than cleanup close or automated repair.

options.title: Merge after refresh
options.body: Refresh or merge against current main and land if required checks remain green, because the exact-head release gate proved the changed path.

options.title: Hold for CI policy review
options.body: Pause only if maintainers want `native-i18n` manual dispatches to keep using Blacksmith despite the docs and sibling job pattern.

recommendation.title: Merge after refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh or merge against current main and land if required checks remain green, because the exact-head release gate proved the changed path.
